title: The Iran Reckoning with Afshon Ostovar Archives
gist: A tag archive index page (not an article) listing 15 episodes of 'The Iran Reckoning with Afshon Ostovar' from March to July 2026; the episode titles alone trace an active war with Iran, a June understanding with Washington that broke down by mid-July, and the Houthis entering the war on July 31.

themes.theme: Iran War Timeline from Episode Index

insights.claim: An episode titled 'The Houthis Enter the War' dated July 31, 2026 indicates the Houthis became a belligerent in the Iran conflict at end-July, widening the Red Sea maritime risk set.
insights.speaker: War on the Rocks
insights.so_what: Houthi entry re-prices Red Sea shipping and war-risk insurance; watch tanker routing away from Bab el-Mandeb.
insights.locator: Tag: The Iran Reckoning with Afshon Ostovar

insights.claim: The sequence 'Iran and the United States Reach an Understanding — Sort Of' (June 19) followed by 'The War Is Back On' (July 18) shows the June U.S.-Iran understanding lasted roughly a month before hostilities resumed.
insights.speaker: War on the Rocks
insights.so_what: A one-month half-life on the last U.S.-Iran understanding sets the base rate for how long to trust the next de-escalation headline.
insights.locator: Tag: The Iran Reckoning with Afshon Ostovar

insights.claim: The series has repeatedly returned to the Strait of Hormuz and oil market impacts as recurring listener and editorial concerns since March 2026.
insights.speaker: War on the Rocks
insights.so_what: Hormuz and Iranian oil supply have been the dominant transmission channel from this war to markets for five straight months.
insights.quote: Iran’s Succession Politics, War Aims, and Oil Market Impacts
insights.locator: Tag: The Iran Reckoning with Afshon Ostovar

insights.claim: Episode topics span regime fracture, succession politics, repression aftermath, and potential regime collapse, indicating sustained analyst focus on Iranian domestic political instability rather than only the military campaign.
insights.speaker: War on the Rocks
insights.so_what: Regime-continuity risk, not just strike risk, is the tail scenario being tracked — it dominates long-dated Iranian oil supply assumptions.
insights.quote: Is the Iranian Regime Truly Fractured?
insights.locator: Tag: The Iran Reckoning with Afshon Ostovar

insights.claim: Arab Gulf states' responses and Iran's missile war were treated as distinct analytical threads early in the conflict (March 2026), signaling the war was regional in scope from its opening weeks.
insights.speaker: War on the Rocks
insights.so_what: Gulf state alignment has been in play since March — GCC infrastructure and sovereign risk are inside the blast radius, not adjacent to it.
insights.quote: How Arab Gulf States Are Responding to the War with Iran
insights.locator: Tag: The Iran Reckoning with Afshon Ostovar
